My memory holds no request from the owner to reduce the number of running delegates.

The closest thing is his CI/tests rule: "delegate count is not a target," alongside no long, wasteful or repeated CI, and a run repeats only when the code under it changed. That says not to chase a delegate count. It isn't an instruction to cut the number running.

I also left the Apple gate slot count at 1 and held the 2-slot proposal myself, because the Mac has about 10.7 GB of swap in use. That was my call, not his.
